keyFindings.description: htmlEnd now treats any '<' plus letter as an open tag and jumps quoted values, so it masks text micromark does not read as a tag. 'See here and` then more.' is joined, exit 0: the inline code value changes from 'here and' (two spaces rendered) to 'here and'. 'See here and then more.' loses a line break inside , which round 5 keeps because GitHub shows it. Fix: accept only a CommonMark open tag (tag name [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*, then its attribute grammar).

The guard folds whitespace in inlineCode values, so any mask misread inside a code span is written with exit 0: 'See [a](b `c d) e \nf` g.' (destinationEnd) is joined to 'e f'. Compare inlineCode values exactly, as round 6 did for inline html; relayout never changes masked text, so no false refusal.

Round 8's idempotence rule covers a tag alone on its line but not the other whole-line block starts in CONTINUATION_BLOCK_START (:81, '[-=*_|: 	]+$'): 'Intro text
:
more text' becomes 'Intro text
: more text' on the first --write and 'Intro text : more text' on the second, exit 0 both. One predicate for lines that only stand alone (task box, tag line, whole-line underline/rule/delimiter) on the previous line, named in joinParagraph's doc.

frontMatterEnd's doc says the compared text is the same on both sides for a block '...' closes; with a later '---' line micromark reads the body as YAML and --write refuses ('a yaml became a yaml'). Refusal is safe; the comment is false. Correct it, or pick the parser from the one reading's closer.
